## Why we rolled our own template

- `PkgTemplates.jl` composes the plugins you pick. `BestieTemplate.jl`
  is a Copier template that applies to an existing package and can be
  taken a feature at a time
- Both are built to be chosen from. We wanted every package identical,
  because a model follows a shape it can see
- The opinionated part, per-backend AD testing and benchmarking, is
  left to you
- What runs now is a central `.github` holding 23 reusable workflows,
  as SciML does, with dependabot keeping them current. A weekly sync
  opens a pull request where a package has drifted

::: {.callout-important}
We should probably have built this on their Copier template rather than
writing our own scaffolder.
:::
